# axm packs unpack

Eject pack into individual entries

## When to use

Eject pack into individual entries

## Usage

```bash
axm packs unpack [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description         |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------- |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Pack name to unpack |

## Flags

| Name                  | Type    | Required | Description                                                  |
| --------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--strict-agent-sync` | boolean | No       | Fail when MCP agent sync has strict-policy failures          |
| `--yes`, `-y`         | boolean | No       | Eject without confirmation                                   |
| `--force`, `-f`       | boolean | No       | Eject even if it would overwrite existing individual entries |
| `--preview`           | boolean | No       | Show what would change in settings without modifying them    |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Stop using a pack and manage extensions individually**

```bash
axm packs unpack @acme/frontend-tools
```

**See what settings would change first**

```bash
axm packs unpack @acme/frontend-tools --preview
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
